$this->pdo->query(\"PRAGMA table_info($table)\");\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n            if ($row['name'] === $column) {\n                return;\n            }\n        }\n        $this->pdo->exec(\"ALTER TABLE $table ADD COLUMN $column $definition\");\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Truncate all data tables and re-seed the schema version marker.\n     *\n     * Also removes legacy
